promise.title: Camera craft meets AI pipeline.
promise.text: TasWiq (تسويق) is Arabic for marketing – and that's the whole point: visuals that don't just look good, but fill tables and sell tickets. faq.q: How quickly will I see the first results?
faq.a: First social clips land 72 hours after the shoot; the finished film follows within 7 to 14 days depending on the package. With Express, everything is delivered within 72 hours.

faq.q: What does the AI do – and what doesn't it do?
faq.a: AI handles the grunt work: edit variants, subtitles, translations, voiceover and format adjustments. Camera, lighting, selection and the final look remain handcrafted. Dishes and guests are always filmed for real.

faq.q: Who owns the rights to the photos and videos?
faq.a: You do. You receive exclusive usage rights to all final files, unlimited in time and territory, as soon as the invoice is paid.

faq.q: What if I don't like the edit?
faq.a: One revision round is included in every package. Additional rounds cost €49.99 – though we rarely need them, because the master plan is agreed upfront.

faq.q: Do you shoot outside your city?
faq.a: Yes – across Germany, Austria and Switzerland, and internationally on request. Travel is billed transparently and included up to 50 km.

faq.q: How do you handle guests on camera and data protection?
faq.a: We announce shoots with notices, only film guests with their consent and provide consent templates. At festivals, we coordinate with the organiser.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draft: Draft – describes the technical data flows of this website. Have it legally reviewed before going live.
privacy.formsText: When you contact us via the funnel or the pricing calculator, we store your details (name, email, optionally phone, company, message, selected services, budget range and calculation) to process your enquiry (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). The data is stored in a Supabase database (hosted in the EU, Frankfurt region) and processed via a self-hosted n8n workflow: a notification to us and a confirmation email to you. We only store your IP address as a salted hash to protect against spam. If no contract results, we delete enquiries after 24 months at the latest.
privacy.calendlyText: We only load the booking calendar after you click. Data is then transferred to Calendly LLC (USA) (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, EU-US Data Privacy Framework).
privacy.videosText: Preview clips are hosted on our own server. Links to YouTube only open in a new tab when you click them.
privacy.rightsText: Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, data portability and objection – a quick email to us is all it takes.
